selection: Purposive public primary-report search for pharmaceutical event/site outcomes. This is not a census or a probability sample of exposed sites.

outcomeDefinition.target: Material weather-related site production disruption beyond precautionary closure alone
outcomeDefinition.positive: Explicit weather-caused stopped or reduced normal manufacturing with actual impairment/recovery; a later limited restart does not erase disruption.
outcomeDefinition.negative: Explicit company confirmation of unaffected/normal site operation, or a completed planned restart plus no serious impact. Negative is not a claim of zero downtime.
outcomeDefinition.precautionary: Planned closure alone is not a positive. A promised restart is not a negative. Ambiguous completed restarts remain censored.
outcomeDefinition.censored: Unknown post-event outcome, pre-event plans, unspecified recovery severity, or incompatible/missing hazard inputs never become operating controls.
outcomeDefinition.timeHorizon: Event-associated material interruption reported in dated primary follow-ups; no uniform hour/day threshold can be identified. Do not interpret this as any shutdown, outage >72h, or a national shortage label.

sources.title: Baxter Reports Third-Quarter 2024 Results
sources.locator: Opening results bullet on North Cove recovery
sources.summary: Baxter reports production recovery at North Cove in November after Helene. The September 29 report independently confirms flooding and production closure.

sources.title: Baxter Provides Update on North Cove, N.C., Facility and Hurricane Helene Relief Plans for Community
sources.quote: affected by flooding due to the storm and is currently closed for production
sources.summary: North Cove manufacturing stopped following site flooding; exact initial interruption time is not given.

sources.title: Baxter Provides Update on Puerto Rico Recovery Status Post Hurricane Maria
sources.quote: limited production activities resumed across its facilities within one week of the storm
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning Baxter’s three Puerto Rico manufacturing sites
sources.summary: All three Puerto Rico sites sustained some structural damage and restarted limited manufacturing. Normal production was still ramping. Jayuya and Aibonito are the two pharmaceutical sites represented here; the shared report is not independent evidence for each site.

sources.title: Amgen Provides Update on Status of Puerto Rico Operations
sources.quote: we expect to resume formulation/filling and small molecule commercial production by the end of October 2017
sources.summary: Juncos had not returned all production operations to normal five weeks after Maria. Uninterrupted patient supply from inventory and other sites does not imply uninterrupted site production.

sources.title: Solutions Supply Update 10.11.2024
sources.quote: was not impacted by the hurricanes and is operating normally
sources.locator: Opening paragraph naming Daytona Beach IV fluids manufacturing plant
sources.summary: Company explicitly confirms Daytona Beach normal operation following Helene and Milton. This establishes material nonfailure; it does not mean no precautionary closure.

sources.title: B. Braun Takes Steps to Secure the Supply of Critical IV Fluids in the US
sources.quote: were not seriously impacted by Hurricane Milton and resumed operations as planned on October 11
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning B. Braun’s IV solutions manufacturing plant
sources.summary: Retrospective confirmation of the planned Daytona Beach restart after precautionary closure. Negative for material unplanned disruption, not for any downtime.

sources.title: Pfizer Injectables Response to Hurricane Florence
sources.quote: underwent an orderly planned shutdown in advance of the hurricane. The manufacturing facility has resumed operations
sources.summary: Rocky Mount shutdown was planned and operations had resumed by September 26. The exact restart date, normal output, and absence of serious operational impairment are unspecified; keep outcome censored for this endpoint.

sources.title: Nephron Pharmaceuticals Continues Production Despite Hurricane Florence
sources.locator: Opening paragraph; publication is before storm arrival
sources.summary: The report confirms pre-storm operation and an intention to remain open. It cannot confirm post-storm nonfailure.

sources.title: Pfizer’s Rocky Mount Facility Restarts Production Amid First Phase of Post-Tornado Recovery Efforts
sources.quote: following severe damage from a tornado that hit the site on July 19
sources.summary: Verified production disruption and majority-line restart September 25. A direct convective tornado strike has no compatible input for the tropical-cyclone tornado probability used by run.ts.

sources.title: Examining HHS’ Public Health Preparedness for and Response to the 2017 Hurricane Season
sources.quote: About 8 percent of the medicines consumed by Americans
sources.summary: Primary regulatory context for island manufacturing exposure and response. Aggregate testimony is not assigned as an outcome to unnamed sites.

sources.title: Baxter 2017 Form 10-K, Item 2 Properties
sources.locator: Item 2 Properties: table of principal manufacturing facilities; also lists Jayuya and Guayama
sources.summary: Contemporaneous property list verifies Aibonito and Jayuya were Baxter manufacturing sites in 2017. The all-three-sites recovery report can be linked to these plants without assuming current registrations imply historical operation.

observations.outcomeRationale: Flooding closed production; subsequent recovery extended into November. Date is the event date, not an inferred precise shutdown hour.
Company explicitly says its Daytona plant was not impacted by the hurricanes and was operating normally. No zero-downtime claim.
Company explicitly confirms no serious impact and completed planned October 11 restart. Precautionary closure alone is outside the material-disruption target.
The company report applies to all three Puerto Rico facilities, including Jayuya: limited rather than normal manufacturing after the storm.
The company report applies to all three Puerto Rico facilities, including Aibonito. This shares a report and event with Jayuya; independence is not established.
Formulation/filling and small molecule production had not resumed five weeks after Maria despite uninterrupted patient supply.
Planned shutdown and completed restart reported, but restart date, output recovery and serious-impact status are insufficient for a material-disruption label.
observations.exclusionReason: Planned shutdown and completed restart reported, but restart date, output recovery and serious-impact status are insufficient for a material-disruption label.

observations.outcomeRationale: Pre-storm operating statement and future intent; no verified post-event site outcome.
observations.exclusionReason: Pre-storm operating statement and future intent; no verified post-event site outcome.

observations.outcomeRationale: Outcome is known positive, but no compatible TC tornado probability, site total rainfall or site sustained wind reconstruction exists for this convective event. Do not substitute EF3 wind for windKt or a direct hit for probability.
observations.exclusionReason: Outcome is known positive, but no compatible TC tornado probability, site total rainfall or site sustained wind reconstruction exists for this convective event. Do not substitute EF3 wind for windKt or a direct hit for probability.

sourceRules: No outcome inferred from silence, absence of an FDA shortage, market share, or site exposure.
FDA aggregate disaster testimony is context, not site-specific labels.
Baxter Jayuya and Aibonito share the all-sites company report; fit sensitivity must address storm clustering.
No broader industrial-domain outcome transfer or synthetic training labels.
